name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
summary: With the shrunken head delivered in A Strange Request, Neeru Fireblade hands you the herbs and asks you to carry them to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas, along with word that Neeru is satisfied with the head.

sections.title: The Herbs Go Back
sections.body: After A Strange Request, Neeru Fireblade gives you a pouch of herbs for Witch Doctor Uzer'i. You are also asked to tell Uzer'i that Neeru is satisfied with the shrunken head. The pouch is bound for Uzer'i in Feralas.

sections.title: The Ritual Begins
sections.body: Uzer'i says the herbs are just what is needed to prepare the muisek vessel, and hopes his latest incantations prove as powerful as he had hoped. He asks you to wait a moment while he performs the ritual and applies the herbs.

faq.q: Who gives the herbs to Witch Doctor Uzer'i?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade, the one you brought the shrunken head to.

aliases: where do i take the herb pouch
faq.answer: To Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

faq.q: Was Neeru pleased with the shrunken head?
faq.answer: Yes. Neeru is satisfied with the head and asks you to say so to Uzer'i.
